lines 334-341 map role and notification keys to 'Owner', 'Admin', 'Member', 'Weekly digest', 'New members'; 370-374 fallback humanises unknown keys; 363-368 formats ISO dates; no ids, enum values or codes shown

Load spinner and text (195, 451-453); role and notification spinners via is-busy (510, 675); remove row dims with spinner (568-569); 'Sending invite to ...' (625); 'Saving...' (723). Calls last at most 1.5s so no progress or cancel needed

Invite form: email is required and role is a select that always has a value (209-216). Name form has one required field (256). No optional fields exist
Validation runs only in the submit handlers (612-620, 709-714); the input listeners (601-603, 700-703) only clear an existing error while typing and never raise one

lines 617-618, 639-640, 643-644, 711-712, 733-734: focus moves to the invalid input; setFieldError sets aria-invalid (419); inputs reference their error with aria-describedby (209, 256)

lines 607 and 707: the handlers return early while inviting/renaming is true; the button gets aria-disabled with dimmed style and progress cursor (67, 624, 722) and the status reads 'Sending invite to ...' / 'Saving...' until the response

Invite: new highlighted row plus status (628-635). Rename: 'Team renamed to ...' (729). Role and notification: value stays and spinner stops, or reverts with a message (434-439). Remove: row removed and count updated (586-587). Failures always stated

line 635 shows 'Invited <email> as a member.' while the new row is appended and highlighted in the table (629-631); line 584 shows a persistent 'was removed and no longer has access' message while the row disappears and the seat count updates (586-587)

showMsg (377-400) adds messages with Try again and Dismiss that stay until dismissed or replaced; no setTimeout removes any message; form errors (646, 648, 736) and the load error (460) persist until the next attempt or edit

lines 546-550 and 269-275: dialog 'Remove <name> from <team>?' with 'They lose access at once. You can invite them again later.', buttons 'Keep on team' and 'Remove from team', focus on 'Keep on team'. 'Permanently' would not be true here
The only confirmation is the remove dialog (269-276, 546-551), guarding a rare action that ends a person's access at once; invite, rename, role change, toggles and dismiss have none
